It builds a behavior profile from historical trajectories and flags deviations for offline Agent security self-checks, SOC analyst triage, or pre-deployment behavior auditing. 11 of 12 rules are zero-network; the output-intent rule requires an externally injected LLM client and is disabled by default. It is a local offline analysis tool, not a runtime guardrail.
